Tara (Product): Heads-up: rolling Private Telemetry Opt-out v2 to on-prem/VPC today 14:00 UTC. This change adds a local toggle for telemetry categories + an audit endpoint for customers to verify opt-out state. Goal: give regulated customers explicit control and an auditable verification flow.

Omar (Eng): Implementation notes: toggle lives in agent config (telemetry.categories=[usage,errors,diagnostics]). Agent exposes GET /agent/telemetry/state and POST /agent/telemetry/verify which returns a signed statement: {state_id, categories, timestamp, signer}. Example: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://127.0.0.1:8443/agent/telemetry/state```

Ivy (SRE): Rollout plan: 5-customer canary 14:00-14:15, monitor "telemetry-state-mismatch" and agent-heartbeat drops. If mismatch >0.2% for 5m, rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for telemetry-optout-v2 at 2026-04-10T14:00Z.

Tara (Product): Action items: Legal - review signed statement language; Support - add KB steps for verifying local opt-out; Sales - prepare 1-line customer blurb and FAQ.

Ben (Legal): Quick check: signed statement needs signer key id and claim that no telemetry categories listed are transmitted. Also request a short sentence customers can use in audits.

Hannah (Sales): TL;DR request: 20-30 words. Also need a list of canary customers so CSMs can proactively reach out in case of regressions.

Omar (Eng): Draft TL;DR: "On-prem deployments can locally opt out of telemetry categories; each opt-out produces a signed verification bundle customers can store for audits." Full FAQ to #docs after GA.

Ivy (SRE): Canary metrics at 14:10: 5 agents returned state, 0 mismatches, median response 35ms. Proceeding to broad rollout at 14:18.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Full rollout initiated for telemetry-optout-v2 at 2026-04-10T14:18Z.

Ben (Legal): Approved audit sentence: "The customer-controlled agent is configured to suppress telemetry categories X; the platform does not receive those categories from this agent." Legal sign-off granted pending final KB link.

Leo (Support): Adding verification steps: 1) call /agent/telemetry/state 2) call /agent/telemetry/verify and save signed bundle 3) if signer validation fails, collect agent logs and escalate to SRE. Will link KB when done.

Tara (Product): Post-rollout: schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize GA copy. Sales, please hold public-facing announcement until Support/Ken confirm KB links. If any anomalies, tag #eng-oncall and @Tara.

Hannah (Sales): Got it. Preparing customer note. Thanks all.
